card.name: Container and closure handling instructions
card.fires_on: Words inside storage and preparation instructions about containers, caps and bottles, such as "tight, light resistant container", "child-resistant cap" and "keep tightly closed". It also fires on a few other physical-handling words, like mm in book dimensions.

modes.label: Container wording
modes.description: Words describing the container or its closure in storage or dispensing directions.
modes.example: Store tranylcypromine sulfate tablets in a tight, light<< resistant>> container.

modes.label: Mixing and handling steps
modes.description: Linking words in steps for mixing, crushing or reconstituting a product in a container.
modes.example: • Gently invert the bag<< to>> mix the solution.

modes.label: Physical size units
modes.description: The unit mm after a number in product dimensions.

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens are mixed and mostly unrelated, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up on practical wording about bottles, caps, containers and how to handle or mix a product.
